recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to light gray (#F0F0F0). 2. Add a thin gray border rectangle around the slide edges. 3. Insert a text box centered horizontally at approximately 40% from top; type '[1] Ridge Regularizer to Minimize Overfitting' in bold red (#C00000), large sans-serif font. 4. Insert a second text box centered below the title at approximately 55% from top; type '(Also Known as L2 regularizer)' in italic blue (#0000CC), medium sans-serif font. 5. Draw a yellow (#FFFF00) filled circle with thin black outline in the top-right corner; add the number '8' in black centered inside it. 6. Ensure no other graphics or bullets are present.
